details.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$now=Get-Date; git status --porcelain=v1 | ForEach-Object { if($_.Length -ge 4){ $p=$_.Substring(3); if($p -notlike '.coding-tools/*' -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)){ $i=Get-Item -LiteralPath $p; if(($now-$i.LastWriteTime).TotalSeconds -lt 180){ [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p;AgeSec=[math]::Round(($now-$i.LastWriteTime).TotalSeconds,1);LastWrite=$i.LastWriteTime.ToString('o');Length=$i.Length} } } } } | Sort-Object AgeSec | Format-Table -AutoSize"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$now=Get-Date; git status --porcelain=v1 | ForEach-Object { if($_.Length -ge 4){ $p=$_.Substring(3); if($p -notlike '.coding-tools/*' -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)){ $i=Get-Item -LiteralPath $p; if(($now-$i.LastWriteTime).TotalSeconds -lt 180){ [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p;AgeSec=[math]::Round(($now-$i.LastWriteTime).TotalSeconds,1);LastWrite=$i.LastWriteTime.ToString('o');Length=$i.Length} } } } } | Sort-Object AgeSec | Format-Table -AutoSize"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Get-ChildItem '.coding-tools/task-contexts' -Filter '*.json' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 25 | ForEach-Object { try { $j=Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{File=$_.Name;LastWrite=$_.LastWriteTime.ToString('o');Status=$j.status;Task=$j.task_id;Objective=([string]$j.objective).Substring(0,[Math]::Min(140,([string]$j.objective).Length));Run=$j.orchestration.run_id;Wave=$j.orchestrat
